statistics_definition.independent_resonance_rule: One resonance per distinct spectral location; finite-N repeats and independent-method confirmations share an independence_group and are not double-counted.
statistics_definition.re_std: Population standard deviation over the included re values: sqrt(sum((re - re_mean)^2)/n).
